# The construction-retain matrix: struct-literal FIELD KIND x VALUE SHAPE,
# verdicts per compiler (native selfhost). Regenerate with
# FERN_CONSTRUCTION_RETAIN_DUMP=1 (and -v). Exits match native on every cell
# and the underflow guard is 0 everywhere: every divergence below is a
# LEAK-direction floor — an uncounted share the release side then cannot
# reclaim — which is the killer-drops wave's burn-down list. Native is clean
# on all 35 cells: every share is counted there and fields drop at the box's
# rc-death.
#
# The shape axis: fresh = inline literal/ctor (sole-owned, no-inc baseline);
# local = bare ident of a fresh local, both claims live; param = bare ident
# of a param the caller keeps; fieldread = q.f off a live sibling holder
# (the flatten__RewriteCtx class); call = producer result.
str__fresh          clean clean  fresh concat is Owned, handed over uncounted and dropped
str__local          clean leak   bare string local: retain gated on slit_reclaim + ownership; P not strfldok-admitted here
str__param          clean leak   same gate, param origin
str__fieldread      clean leak   string field read: retain gated on strfldok admission, not granted here
str__call           clean clean  producer result is Owned
str_arr__fresh      clean clean  fresh string[] literal owned by the holder
str_arr__local      clean leak   bare string[] local into the field: uncounted (the documented hole)
str_arr__param      clean leak   same, param origin
str_arr__fieldread  clean leak   the RewriteCtx shape, string[] flavor
str_arr__call       clean clean  producer result owned
arr_i32__fresh      clean clean  fresh scalar-array literal
arr_i32__local      clean clean  the #3292 dup: bare scalar-array ident is retained and balanced
arr_i32__param      clean clean  same dup, param origin
arr_i32__fieldread  clean clean  counted: the literal retains the read and the source keeps its deep drop
arr_i32__call       clean clean  producer result owned
struct__fresh       clean clean  fresh Inner literal
struct__local       clean leak   bare Inner ident: retained (nested-struct arm) but source strands its own claim
struct__param       clean clean  param bare ident retained, param owns nothing to strand
struct__fieldread   clean clean  counted: unconditional nested-struct retain + kept source drop
struct__call        clean clean  strict-fresh call result owned outright
enum__fresh         clean clean  fresh variant ctor owned
enum__local         clean leak   bare enum local: retained (enum arm), source claim strands
enum__param         clean leak   param enum bare ident
enum__fieldread     clean leak   q.f enum read
enum__call          clean leak   enum-returning call: not in the fresh-ctor class, retained, strands
enum_arr__fresh     clean leak   fresh [E.A(..)] literal: enum-array field admission missing even for fresh
enum_arr__local     clean leak   bare enum-array ident
enum_arr__param     clean leak   param enum-array
enum_arr__fieldread clean leak   q.f enum-array read
enum_arr__call      clean leak   enum-array producer result
struct_arr__fresh   clean clean  fresh [Inner{..}] literal owned, deep-dropped
struct_arr__local   clean leak   bare Inner[] ident
struct_arr__param   clean leak   param Inner[]
struct_arr__fieldread clean clean counted: array-of-struct retain + kept source drop
struct_arr__call    clean clean  producer result owned
